verified_license_notes.conclusion: Commercial and noncommercial reuse permitted with explicit source and dataset type and date/state attribution. Original record DATUM_SYS and the OPSI metadata update are not proven to be dataset snapshot dates.

GeoNames states its geographical database is reusable under a Creative Commons attribution license. The 2 source entries are generic search pages rather than unique feature IDs; geographic identity has not been independently vetted.

Mapcarta credits open data from OSM and other sources; its reuse instructions concern map images and underlying OSM/map tiles. No blanket coordinate-copy right asserted for STK. Confirm original source/ODbL attribution or replace with GURS.

rules: Edition counts are not unique physical point counts: nine SZTL race editions share a single Žalec GURS feature, and KZTL reuses four documented place references across 15 races.
License identified does NOT imply that a reviewed coordinate is suitable as an exact start, correctly disambiguated, current or approved for public use.
All 53 source fixtures have reviewStatus=review and approved_for_runtime=false; do not flip flags in batch.
Require provenance, legal attribution/permission, dataset state/date where GURS requires it, start-vs-venue distinction and Master edition identity before any public activation.
Official organizer pages prove event/season information, not necessarily permission to redistribute third-party cartographic data.
Research-only flags and source status remain immutable; public 2027 Wings city correction in Master does not itself approve location coordinates.
Do not assert complete radius coverage for 53/59 candidates: six unlocated and 31 unresolved source-rights editions remain.
